text:
The Pellham Port Authority approved the new harbour levy on Tuesday night by a final vote of 19 to 6, ending a three-hour session that drew steady turnout from shipping firms and dockside vendors. The measure, effective Jan. 1, adds a 1.8% charge on commercial berth fees and is expected to raise 4.2 million crowns in its first year.

Chair Mara Venn said the proceeds will fund dredging, berth lighting, and storm-surge barriers at North Quay. Opponents argued the levy will squeeze margins for smaller operators, but supporters said the port has delayed maintenance for too long.

For the sector, the vote signals firmer cost pass-throughs at secondary harbours as infrastructure bills rise.
